column1: # Tier-D3 CANDIDATE cases (HUNMIN_D3_CLIENT=candidate, issue #53): the F9
# candidate window, drawn for real. Columns are NOT the ordinary D3 ones:
#   <layout>TAB<keys>TAB<expected commit text>TAB<note>
# keys use {F9} (and optionally other {NAMED} tokens) -- xtest-type.py sends
# the keysym. The expected-commit column is written BY HAND, against the
# intended behaviour, because the sim cannot type {F9}: a sim-derived
# expectation for a sequence the sim cannot run would be a fiction, so this
# file names the outcome a person verified and the test checks it.
# An EMPTY third column means "geometry + survival only" -- no commit is
# asserted, which is the right expectation for a case whose point is that
# fcitx5 did not abort.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: no ctest tier drew the F9 window before this one.
# engine-d2-ui has no UI addon; the ordinary D3 disables classicui
# (run-d3.sh's DisabledAddons). The #45 abort lived exactly between them.
# With kMaxCandidatePageSize reverted, the deep case below MUST fail --
# that is the coverage claim, and the repro is tools/repro-f9-candidates.sh.
# Expectations measured 2026-10-15 with the repro script
# (tools/repro-f9-candidates.sh) on the same build, not derived from the sim:
# 간 = sin3-p2 `kfs` resolves to 67 candidates; Return picks the cursor's
# candidate (刊); Down steps the cursor and Return picks 肝. A case with no
# trailing space leaves 간 in the preedit, so F9 opens over it and only the
# explicit Return commits.
# NOTE: `Down,Return` and `Page_Down,Return` both commit 肝, and that is NOT
# the two keys doing the same thing -- 肝 sits at candidate index 1 (a krdict
# word sense) and index 10 (a hanja), so cursor-move and page-move land on the
# same character by coincidence. `Down,Down,Return` -> 間 (index 2) and
# `Page_Down,Page_Down,Return` -> 竿 (index 20) are what distinguish them. See
# wiki/raw/measurements/2026-10-15-f9-candidate-ctest-tier.md.
# The deep case: 67 candidates, the page that aborted fcitx5 uncapped.
sin3-p2
# Return picks the first candidate of the capped page.
sin3-p2
# Down steps the cursor to index 1, then Return picks the candidate there.
sin3-p2
# 낙: an 11-candidate syllable, one past the pre-cap abort edge.
sin3-p2
